title: Impact kernel reference entry
responsibility: Validates requests and exposes the TypeScript reference impact calculation through values or JSON text.

inputs.name: impactKernelText.text
inputs.description: Raw JSON request text that this entry parses before calling impactKernel. Malformed text returns the serialized invalid-json response; parseable JSON is passed through normal portable-JSON admission and dispatch.

inputs.name: impactKernel.request
inputs.description: Any JavaScript value to check with portableJson before dispatch. After admission, only a non-array object with a string operation proceeds; version and impact are the supported operation names.
inputs.unknownReason: The public kernel admits arbitrary caller input, then rejects values outside portable JSON before dispatch.

inputs.name: impactKernelPortable.request
inputs.description: A request already admitted as portable JSON by the caller and supplied for dispatch. The entry accepts only a non-array object with a string operation; it handles version and impact, returning structured failures for unsupported operations or invalid impact inputs.
inputs.unknownReason: Portable JSON alone does not establish whether the envelope is an impact request.

outputs.name: impactKernel
outputs.description: RuntimeResponse returned after portable-JSON admission and operation dispatch. Success contains the version contract or impact closure; invalid requests and unsupported operations are represented as structured failures.

error.message: request must be an object with an operation

outputs.name: impactKernelPortable
outputs.description: RuntimeResponse returned by operation dispatch after the caller has established portable JSON. version returns the contract string and impact returns the merged closure, while request or graph validation failures remain structured responses.

outputs.name: impactKernelText
outputs.description: Serialized RuntimeResponse for the parsed request, preserving the normal kernel success and failure shapes. Malformed JSON text is serialized as the invalid-json response.
